{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float after cleaning
# Remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders using the cleaned float column
internal_test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders (using cleaned float): {len(internal_test_orders)}")

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude internal test orders using the cleaned column
completed_real_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Calculate total revenue from completed real orders
total_revenue = completed_real_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

total_revenue"}
